parsed.post: Latest run reached 0.942888, but it trained on shard 10, which is also the fixed evaluation shard; that result is contaminated and should not be compared. I’m keeping training restricted to shards 0–9 and testing a smaller batch next.
parsed.description: Halve batch size again to test whether more optimizer updates improve validation bpb without training on the evaluation shard.
parsed.report_to_operator: The latest run used TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' while EVAL_SHARD=10, so its 0.942888 result overlaps training and evaluation data. I discarded it and will keep the evaluation shard out of training.
